header.length_confound_note: benign is length-matched (decile-bin stratified) to harmful; compare median_char_length per class
header.dedup_grouping: group_id = sha1(normalized_text)[:16]; surface near-dups (case/space/punct) collapse; no group_id spans both classes

label_scheme.harmful: toxic-chat toxicity==1 or a jailbreak top-up

protocol.scaler: StandardScaler, fit per-fold on train only
protocol.head: 128->32 d0.3 lr0.001 wd0.001

benign_arm.dataset: XSTest (Paul/XSTest CSV; Rottger et al. 2024, arXiv:2308.01263)
benign_arm.role: REPORTED-ONLY - never used to select a cell (that would be OOD test-set peeking); scored zero-shot per CV fold

benign_arm_detail.dataset: XSTest (Paul/XSTest CSV; Rottger et al. 2024, arXiv:2308.01263)
benign_arm_detail.role: REPORTED-ONLY - never used to select a cell (that would be OOD test-set peeking); scored zero-shot per CV fold

appendix_d_flag_rule.quote: sequence-level mean aggregation can achieve high recall on several attack sets but yields near-random XSTest AUROC

shuffle_control.label: L10 mean
shuffle_control.note: labels permuted; roc_auc must collapse to ~0.5 or the whole sweep is leaking
